title: Intel Announces The Intel740 3-D Graphics Accelerator Chip
scope_note: Announces Intel740 chip and says it will be available in volume production to third-party graphics vendors and OEM manufacturers in February 1998.

title: Intel Introduces Intel Express 3D Graphics Card
scope_note: Introduces Intel Express 3D card based on Intel740 and states immediate dealer distributor and system-integrator availability in 2 MB and 4 MB versions.

title: NVIDIA Corporate Timeline 1998
scope_note: Retrospective first-party chronology lists RIVA 128ZX launch in February 1998 and RIVA TNT launch in March 1998; it does not provide exact dates or shipment channels.

title: Matrox announces MGA-G200 high-end 3-D graphics chip
scope_note: Contemporary report says Matrox announced the MGA-G200 on May 1 and notes that concrete products and release dates were not disclosed.

title: ATI announces RAGE 128 family
scope_note: Contemporary report says ATI announced RAGE 128 family on August 27, distinguishes GL and VR chips, and reports sampling begun with September volume production planned.

title: ATI Takes 3D Lead With Rage 128
scope_note: Contemporary technical report distinguishes RAGE 128 VR and GL packages and says selected-OEM sampling began in August with October volume production expected.

title: 3Dfx announces Voodoo Banshee integrated 2-D/3-D video chip
scope_note: Contemporary report says 3Dfx announced Voodoo Banshee on June 22 and links the original company release; Banshee-card availability was expected August or September.
